tech.trend: Trading below the whole moving-average stack, under a flat 200-day; fresh golden-cross
tech.summary: The price closed 1.50 below a falling 20-day (1.60), a flat 50-day (1.62) and a flat 200-day (1.62). Momentum is washed out: RSI(14) is ~29 and the daily ATR near 0.03 (~2.3%) points to a normal tape. MACD (12·26·9) is negative and still falling (−0.02 / −0.01 / −0.01). The 50-day crossed above the 200-day 16 sessions ago — a fresh golden-cross, a momentum-regime change rather than noise inside an intact trend. Over the last year it has ranged 1.48–1.96; the last close sits 23% below that high and 1% above that low.
tech.bull: A daily close back above 1.56 would clear the nearest resistance and open the 1.68 zone.
tech.bear: A close below 1.47 would break the nearest support and open the 1.30 zone.
